purpose: Confirmatory stress gate with no post-hoc analysis step: static-runtime BridgeStan DLLs under unserialised multi-replica dispatch (the configuration an opt-in would ship) vs dynamic-DLL positive controls, in the WP50B/WP50C reproducing configuration.
code_path: this worktree HEAD sampler and BridgeStan integration (child/ built by build_child.py). static_unserialised and dynamic_unserialised use the study-local Unserialised target (4 independently loaded model copies, per-replica mutex, free-replica dispatch, resident libraries, no owned worker, no process-global lock; identical to WP50C Phase C). dynamic_owned uses HEAD ReplicatedStanTarget (owned worker).

launcher.name: powershell
launcher.environment: registry Machine;User PATH (WinLibs bin resolves the mingw runtime for dynamic DLLs), Git Bash variables removed

launch_dirs: build/arms/<arm>/ each holds only a byte-identical copy of the child exe; the Event 1000 application path therefore identifies the arm

static_unserialised.role: gate arm: static-runtime DLLs, unserialised multi-replica (what an opt-in would ship)

dynamic_unserialised.role: PRIMARY positive control: old dynamic DLLs on the same unserialised target (WP50C Phase B 2/120)

dynamic_owned.role: coordinator literal control: old dynamic DLLs with the HEAD owned worker (bridgestan_owned_worker_v1: 0/540), so expected NOT to reproduce; reported under its own verdict reading

ordering: single-arm blocks of 10 (100 static, 30 + 30 control). The j-th of an arm's n blocks gets key (j+0.5)/n; blocks run by ascending key, ties in arm order (static, dynamic_unserialised, dynamic_owned); seeds ascending within an arm; strictly sequential, one child at a time.
module_recording: every child records the full path and size of libwinpthread-1/libgcc_s_seh-1/libstdc++-6/tbb mapped after load (load/after heartbeat and raw output) and after target drop (drop/after); null = not mapped. A static child is a manipulation failure if either snapshot contradicts the static expectation; a dynamic child if load/after contradicts the dynamic expectation.

event_correlation.rule: An Application Error Event 1000 (captured once after the run over the whole run window) is attributed to a child iff ALL hold: (a) properties[10] application path equals that child arm exe path (case-insensitive); (b) properties[8] PID (decimal; 0x-prefixed parsed as hex) equals the child PID from its heartbeats; (c) the event time is within [launcher start - before_seconds, launcher end + after_seconds]. An event is attributed to at most one child. Events on any arm exe path that match no child, or more than one, are unattributed and reported.
event_correlation.unattributed_static: an unattributed event whose application path is the static arm exe counts as a static fault (conservative); unattributed control-path events are reported and never count toward control reproduction
event_correlation.frozen_in_code: run_gate.py correlate(), unit-tested in test_run_gate.py before any evidence

classification.fault: launcher timeout, nonzero launcher return code, missing/non-ok raw output, heartbeat sequence != expected_heartbeats, or an attributed Event 1000 (hidden exit-0 crash events included)
classification.heap_corruption: launcher return code 0xC0000374 or attributed Event 1000 exception code c0000374

decision_rule.supported: static_unserialised 0/1000 faults (event-inclusive) AND primary control >= 1 fault AND 0 static manipulation failures AND all 1600 records present
decision_rule.literal_reading: the same rule with dynamic_owned as the control is also computed and reported (verdict_control_dynamic_owned); it is expected to be inconclusive because the owned worker suppressed the fault in 540/540 children in bridgestan_owned_worker_v1
decision_rule.reported_either_way: exact one-sided (control > static) and two-sided Fisher p for each control vs static; one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson upper bound on the static fault rate (= 1 - 0.05^(1/1000) = 0.00299 at 0/1000)

no_reruns: single launch; failures are results; an interrupted child is recorded as interrupted_not_relaunched
